header.question: Q6: do the Autos block until done, how long do they take, and what does one that cannot run return? Auto Output Zero, Auto Pipette Offset and Auto Fast Capacitance in V-Clamp, with the DLL's timeout at 3000 ms (its default) and then 10000 ms; then two that should not run: Auto Bridge Balance (I-Clamp only) in V-Clamp, and Auto Whole Cell at Rf 5 GOhm, where Whole Cell is off. Each call is timed and the readings it changes are read before it and 0-5 s after it returned, with a snapshot before and after; whatever it changed is put back before the next, and the Pipette Offset padlock is clicked open.
header.setup: amplifier on, nothing attached to the headstage (--no-cell-attached)
